name: nginx-multisite
description: Configures an Nginx web server for three configurable sites, including static content, virtual hosts, development TLS certificates, firewall rules, Fail2ban, sysctl security settings, and SSH hardening.

name: cache
description: Installs and enables Memcached and Redis, configures Redis logging, authentication, and listener settings, and applies compatibility cleanup to the generated Redis configuration.

name: fastapi-tutorial
description: Deploys a FastAPI application with Python and PostgreSQL, including application checkout, virtual environment and dependency installation, database and user creation, environment configuration, and a systemd-managed Uvicorn service.
